preconditions.description: The input number must be a string.

postconditions.expression: (return_value == 'In with a chance' and (number.replace('-', '').startswith('07') or number.replace('-', '').startswith('+447')) and len(number.replace('-', '')) == 11) or (return_value == 'Plenty more fish in the sea' and not (number.replace('-', '').startswith('07') or number.replace('-', '').startswith('+447')) or len(number.replace('-', '')) != 11)
postconditions.description: If the number is valid (starts with '07' or '+447' and has exactly 11 digits without dashes), return 'In with a chance'. Otherwise, return 'Plenty more fish in the sea'.
